tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: The sidebar and other furniture that sits behind the page.

tokens.name: paper-active
tokens.usage: The current navigation item and hovered rows on paper-sunk.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the index card, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: A card inside a card: AMS slot cards inside the printer card.

tokens.name: case
tokens.usage: Inside of a shelf case, behind the spines.

tokens.name: plank
tokens.usage: The shelf plank under the spines. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Card borders and the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Ruled lines inside cards: index-card fields, ledger rows, meter track.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, pills, inputs and dashed empty slots. Holds 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and vellum in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-sunk, paper-active, paper-raised, vellum and case.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on the same grounds as ink.

tokens.name: sepia
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, links, eyebrows, accession numbers, the remaining-weight meter. As text on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: sepia-deep
tokens.usage: Hover for primary buttons; text on sepia-soft.

tokens.name: sepia-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for loan and in-progress chips, behind sepia-deep text.

tokens.name: on-sepia
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sepia or sepia-deep fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Low stock, overdue for drying, destructive actions, date stamps and the index card's top rule. As text on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: oxblood-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind oxblood text in warning chips.

tokens.name: on-oxblood
tokens.usage: Text on an oxblood fill: the Low stock sticker.

tokens.name: ledger-blue
tokens.usage: Good state: on the shelf, dried, returned. Stamp-pad blue rather than green, so it never relies on red versus green. As text on paper, paper-raised and ledger-soft.

tokens.name: ledger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ledger-blue text in chips.

tokens.name: swatch-ground
tokens.usage: Neutral ground behind every filament colour, in both themes, so colours read true against the warm paper.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline round swatches and the spool drawing, so white and clear filaments keep an edge.

tokens.name: spine-edge
tokens.usage: Inner keyline on book spines; gives the eye a white reference against dark filament colours.

tokens.name: print-paper
tokens.usage: Label stock. Bookplates are always black on white, whatever the theme.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: Label ink on print-paper.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of sepia.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Literata names things: spools, shelves, printers, screens. Loaded from Google Fonts (opsz 7–72, weights 400 and 600, italic 400).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and the title of an index card. One per screen.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name in the sidebar. There is no logo yet.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Printer names and major section headings.

styles.name: spine
styles.usage: Colour names set vertically on book spines.

styles.name: marginalia
styles.sample: Lovely on the textured plate at 215 °C.
styles.usage: The person's own notes about a spool.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans carries the interface.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 32 spools on three shelves · 18.7 kg in stock

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Shown on neutral white for true colour

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrow above a display title, set in uppercase, in sepia.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table headers and panel labels, uppercase, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for anything counted, dated or catalogued, so figures line up.

styles.name: accession
styles.usage: Accession numbers and shelf marks, in sepia.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Date stamps on circulation records, uppercase, in oxblood.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between spines on a shelf; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows and buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between slot cards; control side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small cards and the shelf case.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen; card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Index card side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding; gap between the two catalogue columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding at desktop width.

radius.note: Paper and wood: small corners. Only pills, stickers and swatches are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Spine tops and date stamps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, navigation items, the shelf case.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: index card, printer card, slot cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills, status chips, stickers and swatch discs.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layouts rely on.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, pill, input and navigation item.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: The main action on a record page.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: shelf-height
tokens.usage: Height of a shelf case; spines run 132–158px inside it.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the work. One card elevation, one inset for the shelf case, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The index card and anything lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-case
tokens.usage: Inside a shelf case, so the spines sit in a recess.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper-coloured gap, then 2px of solid sepia. At least 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and case in both themes.
